annotations.title: Account Billing Lifecycle, Multi-Rail Session Credit & Quota Inspector

description: Inspects account billing lifecycle, prepaid multi-rail credit (GRLC, Lightning sats, Base USDC, Solana), session key validity, and allocates streaming token quotas. Use when verifying prepaid balance, inspecting top-up deposit addresses, or initializing metered MPP inference sessions; for mapping a high-level task to MCP tools, use route_mcp_workflow_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'action' ('lifecycle_stage' defaults to 'active_session'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400.

action.description: Operation: 'check_billing_lifecycle' to inspect balance/deposit addresses, or 'allocate_session' to plan metered streaming quota.

task.description: Agent workflow task to execute within the metered MPP session.

token_quota_tier.description: Allocated streaming token ceiling for the session; defaults to 'standard_4096' when omitted.

name: infer_mpp_streaming_session

account_status.description: Account status: active, funded, or unauthenticated.

balances.description: Prepaid balance breakdown across GRLC, Lightning sats, Base USDC, and Solana.

deposit_addresses.description: Multi-rail payment addresses for topping up account balance.

plan.description: Ordered execution steps generated for the task.

streaming_tokens_allocated.description: Token budget reserved for the session.

title: Account Billing Lifecycle, Multi-Rail Session Credit & Quota Inspector
